notes: Candidates and parties are from the Department of Elections 'General Election 11/3/2026 Filed Candidates by Office' list, last updated 2026-10-22 07:56 PM; only candidates with status 'Qualified' are included.
U.S. House at-large: Republican Lee Murphy filed 7/13/2026 and is marked 'WITHDRAWN 7/21/2026'; he is left out. Joseph "Dr. Joe" Arminio is the qualified Republican.
State Treasurer is an open seat (incumbent Colleen Davis not running, per WHYY); Ted Lauzen is the only Democrat on the official general list after the Sept. 15 primary.
The official list abbreviates Austin Cassidy's party as 'Ind Pty of DE'; spelled out here as Independent Party of Delaware.

No statewide measures: Delaware amends its constitution by two-thirds votes of two successive General Assemblies with no popular vote, and the official general-election page lists no ballot questions.
Polls are open 7 a.m. until 8 p.m. on General Election Day, November 3, 2026 (official general election page). Delaware is entirely Eastern time; 8 PM EST (UTC-5, DST ended Nov 1) = 01:00 UTC Nov 4.
